entries.en: Adda left a spare key with the neighbour before leaving.
entries.zh: 阿达出发前把一把备用钥匙交给了邻居。

entries.en: We reset the adder-accumulator before starting the next sequence of calculations.
entries.zh: 开始下一轮计算前，我们重置了加法累加器。

entries.en: A loose connection prevented the adder-subtracter from receiving either input.
entries.zh: 一处松动的连接使加减器无法接收到两个输入中的任何一个。

entries.en: The students built an adder-subtractor and checked its output against their calculations.
entries.zh: 学生们搭建了一个加减器，并把它的输出与自己的计算结果核对。

entries.en: Addi needed a ladder to retrieve the kite from the roof.
entries.zh: 阿迪需要用梯子把屋顶上的风筝取下来。

entries.en: The game's addictiveness worried him more than its price.
entries.zh: 比起价格，他更担心这款游戏令人上瘾的特点。

entries.en: Addie insisted on carrying the cake herself.
entries.zh: 艾迪坚持要自己拿蛋糕。

entries.en: The parcel arrived while Addin was walking the dog.
entries.zh: 包裹送到时，阿丁正在遛狗。

entries.en: An ornate porch was a later additament to the plain stone house.
entries.zh: 那座朴素的石屋后来增建了一座华丽的门廊。

entries.en: Additon offered to repair the chair instead of replacing it.
entries.zh: 阿迪顿提出修理这把椅子，而不是换掉它。

entries.en: One faulty addon prevented the browser from opening new tabs.
entries.zh: 一个有故障的插件使浏览器无法打开新标签页。

entries.en: The engineer checked the memory's addressability before changing the firmware.
entries.zh: 工程师在更改固件前检查了内存的可寻址能力。

entries.en: The addresser jammed halfway through printing the envelopes.
entries.zh: 邮件地址印刷机在打印信封的中途卡住了。

entries.en: The bank asked the addressor to clarify a clause in the letter.
entries.zh: 银行请发信人澄清信中的一项条款。

entries.en: Addy had already washed the dishes when we returned.
entries.zh: 我们回来时，阿迪已经洗好了碗碟。

entries.en: Adea's bright scarf was easy to spot in the crowded cloakroom.
entries.zh: 阿德亚那条鲜艳的围巾在拥挤的衣帽间里很显眼。

entries.en: Adebayo missed the opening announcement but found an empty seat.
entries.zh: 阿德巴约没听到开场通知，但找到了一个空座位。

entries.en: Could you tell Adebisi that the rehearsal starts at six?
entries.zh: 你能告诉阿德比西，排练六点开始吗？

entries.en: An email from Adecco arrived while I was updating my CV.
entries.zh: 我正在更新简历时，收到了一封阿第克公司的邮件。

entries.en: Adeel saved the last slice of melon for our guest.
entries.zh: 阿迪勒把最后一片甜瓜留给了我们的客人。

entries.en: The map Adega brought showed a path around the lake.
entries.zh: 阿德加带来的地图标出了一条环湖小路。

entries.en: Adel waited for the paint to dry before replacing the handle.
entries.zh: 阿德尔等油漆干了以后才把把手装回去。

entries.en: Adela could hear the rain through the open window.
entries.zh: 阿德拉能听见敞开的窗外传来的雨声。

entries.en: After searching every drawer, Adelard found the receipt in a book.
entries.zh: 阿德拉德翻遍了所有抽屉，最后在一本书里找到了收据。

entries.en: Adelbert's suitcase was too wide for the narrow overhead shelf.
entries.zh: 阿德尔伯特的行李箱太宽，放不进头顶狭窄的行李架。

entries.en: Adelheid fitted a new strap to the borrowed camera before returning it.
entries.zh: 阿德尔海德在归还借来的相机之前，给它装了一根新背带。

entries.en: Adeline paused at the doorway to shake snow from her coat.
entries.zh: 艾德琳在门口停下来，抖掉外套上的雪。

entries.en: The collector examined the adelite through a magnifying glass.
entries.zh: 收藏者用放大镜仔细查看那块砷钙镁石。

entries.en: Adell remembered the tune but could not recall the words.
entries.zh: 阿德尔记得曲调，却想不起歌词。

entries.en: We asked Adella to choose the music for the journey.
entries.zh: 我们请阿代拉挑选旅途中播放的音乐。

entries.en: Adelle caught the vase before it reached the floor.
entries.zh: 花瓶还没落地，阿德尔就接住了它。

entries.en: Adelman paid for the broken plate without being asked.
entries.zh: 没人要求，阿德尔曼就主动赔付了那只打碎的盘子。

entries.en: Adem took the stairs because the lift was out of service.
entries.zh: 电梯停用了，阿德姆便走了楼梯。

entries.en: The children listened while Ademola described the lost puppy.
entries.zh: 阿德莫拉描述那只走失的小狗时，孩子们听着。

entries.en: The dispute over ademption delayed the distribution of the estate.
entries.zh: 有关遗赠撤销的争议延误了遗产的分配。

entries.en: No date had been set for her adenectomy.
entries.zh: 她的腺切除术还没有定下日期。

entries.en: Her interest in adenology grew during the anatomy course.
entries.zh: 上解剖学课程时，她对腺学的兴趣逐渐加深了。

entries.en: Two adenomata were visible in the enlarged image.
entries.zh: 放大的图像中可以看到两个腺瘤。

entries.en: Ader kept the ticket even after the ink had faded.
entries.zh: 即使票上的墨迹已经褪色，阿德仍保留着它。

entries.en: Adesso turned down the radio so we could hear the directions.
entries.zh: 阿代索把收音机的音量调低，让我们听清指路的话。

entries.en: By the time Adet arrived, the soup was cold.
entries.zh: 阿代到达时，汤已经凉了。

entries.en: Adham finished the sketch in a quiet corner of the room.
entries.zh: 阿扎姆在房间一个安静的角落完成了那幅素描。

entries.en: The adhesive remained intact, but the wooden adherend had split.
entries.zh: 胶粘剂仍完好无损，但木质粘附体已经裂开了。

entries.en: Adhikari brought an umbrella large enough for both of us.
entries.zh: 阿迪卡里带来一把足够我们两个人遮雨的伞。

entries.en: Adia preferred the window seat, so we exchanged tickets.
entries.zh: 阿迪亚更喜欢靠窗的座位，于是我们交换了车票。

entries.en: During compression, heat leakage prevented perfect adiabaticity in the chamber.
entries.zh: 压缩过程中，热量泄漏使腔体无法保持完全绝热。

entries.en: She moved the potted adiantum to make room for the photograph.
entries.zh: 她挪开那盆铁线蕨属植物，给照片腾出了位置。

entries.en: The team tested the panel's adiathermancy before choosing a material.
entries.zh: 团队在选定材料前测试了那块板的不透红外线性。

entries.en: Their tearful adieux continued until the train began to move.
entries.zh: 他们含泪告别，直到火车开动。

entries.en: Adil noticed a small tear while folding the tent.
entries.zh: 阿迪勒折叠帐篷时，发现一个小裂口。

entries.en: A message from Adin explained why the shop was closed.
entries.zh: 阿丁发来消息，解释了商店关门的原因。

entries.en: A single adipocyte occupied most of the microscope image.
entries.zh: 一个脂肪细胞占据了显微图像的大部分区域。

entries.en: Several adipocytes were partly hidden beneath the folded tissue.
entries.zh: 几个脂肪细胞部分遮蔽在折叠的组织下面。

entries.meaningZh: 脂肪形成〔指脂肪细胞形成〕
entries.en: The team compared adipogenesis across the three cell cultures.
entries.zh: 团队比较了这三组细胞培养物中的脂肪细胞形成情况。

entries.en: They repeated the assay after the adipokine concentration changed unexpectedly.
entries.zh: 脂肪因子的浓度意外变化后，他们重复做了那项测定。

entries.en: The factory postponed its purchase of adiponitrile until after the storage inspection.
entries.zh: 工厂把己二腈的采购推迟到仓储检查之后。

entries.en: Adisa hurried back and switched off the kitchen light.
entries.zh: 阿迪萨急忙返回，把厨房的灯关掉。

entries.en: The rain stopped just as Aditya reached the bus shelter.
entries.zh: 阿迪蒂亚刚走到公交候车亭，雨就停了。

entries.en: The adjacence of the two gardens made a shared gate practical.
entries.zh: 两个花园相毗连，设置一扇共用的门很合适。

entries.en: Adjani tried a different key, and the drawer finally opened.
entries.zh: 阿贾尼换了一把钥匙试，抽屉终于打开了。

entries.en: A sign error in the classical adjoint forced us to repeat the calculation.
entries.zh: 经典伴随矩阵中的一个符号错误使我们不得不重新计算。

entries.en: The fountain's adjutage was blocked by a small piece of gravel.
entries.zh: 喷泉的喷射管被一小块碎石堵住了。

entries.en: He accepted the adjutancy only after discussing the move with his family.
entries.zh: 他与家人商量了这次调动后，才接受了副官职位。

entries.en: The adjutantship remained vacant throughout the winter.
entries.zh: 整个冬天，副官职位一直空缺着。

entries.en: After ten years in adland, she opened a small bakery.
entries.zh: 在广告界工作十年后，她开了一家小面包店。

entries.en: Adle checked the pockets once more before washing the trousers.
entries.zh: 洗裤子前，阿德勒又检查了一遍口袋。

entries.en: An adlet in the local paper brought three buyers to the shop.
entries.zh: 当地报纸上的一则小广告给商店招来了三位买家。

entries.en: Adli waited until everyone was seated before serving the rice.
entries.zh: 阿德利等大家都坐好后才盛饭。

entries.en: The gardener lent Adlon a spade for the afternoon.
entries.zh: 园丁借给阿德隆一把铁锹，供当天下午使用。

entries.en: Adly recognised the handwriting and opened the envelope at once.
entries.zh: 阿兹利认出了笔迹，立即打开了信封。

entries.en: The surveyors postponed the admeasurement of the hall until the scaffolding was removed.
entries.zh: 测量员把大厅的测量工作推迟到拆除脚手架之后。

entries.en: Admi left a note explaining how to water the plants.
entries.zh: 阿德米留了一张纸条，说明该怎样给植物浇水。

entries.en: The signed receipt provided an adminicle supporting her account of the payment.
entries.zh: 那张签过字的收据为她对付款情况的陈述提供了旁证。

entries.en: She resigned the administratorship before the new budget was approved.
entries.zh: 新预算获批之前，她辞去了管理人的职位。

entries.meaningZh: 女遗产管理人〔复数，女性称谓〕
entries.en: The two administratrices disagreed about how to catalogue the estate's furniture.
entries.zh: 两位女遗产管理人对如何把遗产中的家具编目存在分歧。

entries.meaningZh: 女遗产管理人〔女性称谓〕
entries.en: As administratrix, she kept every receipt for the estate's expenses.
entries.zh: 作为女遗产管理人，她保留了遗产各项支出的每一张收据。

entries.en: He declined the admiralship because he wanted to remain at sea.
entries.zh: 他想继续留在海上，因此谢绝了海军上将之职。

entries.meaningZh: 大学入学通知书〔美国旧用〕
entries.en: She found her grandfather's admittatur among his old college papers.
entries.zh: 她在祖父旧日的大学文件中找到了他的入学通知书。

entries.meaningZh: 被准许入场者〔美国用语，复数〕
entries.en: The admittees received badges before entering the exhibition hall.
entries.zh: 获准入场的人进入展厅前领到了徽章。

entries.en: A damaged belt brought the admixer to a sudden stop.
entries.zh: 一条损坏的皮带使混合器突然停了下来。

entries.en: Adna chose the smallest table because only two guests were coming.
entries.zh: 因为只会来两位客人，阿德纳选了最小的桌子。

entries.en: Adoff wrapped his coat around the shivering child.
entries.zh: 阿多夫用自己的外套裹住那个冷得发抖的孩子。

entries.en: Throughout his adolescency, he longed to leave the village.
entries.zh: 整个青春期，他都渴望离开那个村庄。

entries.en: Adom returned from the market without the onions we needed.
entries.zh: 阿多姆从市场回来了，却没带回我们需要的洋葱。

entries.en: Adon postponed his walk to enjoy the warm bread.
entries.zh: 阿东为了享用热面包，推迟了散步。

entries.en: The committee questioned the adoptability of a plan that required new taxes.
entries.zh: 委员会质疑一项需要增设税收的计划是否具有可采纳性。

entries.en: The seminar on adoptionism ended with a heated discussion of scripture.
entries.zh: 有关嗣子说的研讨会以一场关于经文的热烈讨论告终。

entries.en: An adoptionist challenged the preacher during the evening debate.
entries.zh: 在晚间的辩论中，一位嗣子说信徒对那位传教士提出了质疑。
